t: Battery powered optical smoke alarm with a 10-year sealed lithium battery for fast and reliable smoke detection. Features advanced optical sensing technology, ideal for detecting slow-burning fires while reducing nuisance alarms from cooking. Powered by a tamperproof sealed battery to ensure uninterrupted protection. The easy-access front cover doubles as a test and silence button for simple operation. Night mode automatically dims the LED indicator for undisturbed sleep, while Sleep Easy silences low battery alerts for up to 10 hours. The ultra-slim design makes it ideal for homes and leisure accommodation vehicles (caravans/campervans). Can be either wall or ceiling mounted.
b: Displays the word 'Alarm' prominently when the alarm is activated
Optical Sensing Technology Reduces Nuisance Cooking Alarms
